authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) & Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)

aluminium.name: Aluminium
aluminium.notes: Binding GEI targets for smelters and refineries on per tonne primary aluminium ingot basis.

cement.name: Cement
cement.notes: Binding GEI targets on per tonne ordinary portland / pozzolana cement basis.

chlor_alkali.name: Chlor-Alkali
chlor_alkali.notes: Binding GEI targets on per tonne caustic soda (100% NaOH equivalent) basis.

pulp_paper.name: Pulp & Paper
pulp_paper.source_document: MoEFCC Notification G.S.R. 25(E) - Pulp & Paper Trajectory
pulp_paper.notes: Binding GEI targets on per tonne finished paper product basis.

petrochemicals.name: Petrochemicals
petrochemicals.notes: Binding GEI targets on cracker and major polymer product basis.

petroleum_refinery.name: Petroleum Refinery
petroleum_refinery.source_document: MoEFCC Notification G.S.R. 25(E) - Petroleum Refinery Trajectory
petroleum_refinery.notes: Binding GEI targets based on composite MBN (Million Barrel Number) complexity factor.

textile.name: Textile
textile.notes: Binding GEI targets for composite textile and spinning-processing units.

iron_steel.name: Iron & Steel
iron_steel.source_document: MoEFCC Notification G.S.R. 88(E) - Iron & Steel Trajectory Schedule
iron_steel.notes: Formally elevated as 8th CCTS compliance sector with subsector trajectories for BF-BOF, DRI-EAF, and Pellet Plants.

fertiliser.name: Fertiliser
fertiliser.source_document: Department of Fertilisers & BEE Transition Roadmap
fertiliser.notes: Watchlist scope undergoing policy integration with National Green Hydrogen Mission and Urea Subsidy Framework.
